name: Quantexa Unify entity resolution for OneLake
description: Quantexa Unify reads data directly from OneLake, automates cleansing, parsing and normalization of data sources, then performs sophisticated data matching to produce a connected view of the data in OneLake.  Quantexa Unify provides preconfigured matching templates, allowing users to define the level of match quality required.
